title: sdks: unify auth / retries / streaming ergonomics + parity fixes and bump v1.108.0
author: Ava Chen
release_notes: Bump SDKs to v1.108.0 with unified auth/retries API, streaming ergonomic improvements, and cross-SDK parity fixes. See details for migration notes.
description:
Summary: This PR harmonizes auth headers, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics across Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and applies a coordinated parity fix and minor API ergonomic surface changes. It also bumps package versions to v1.108.0 across the three SDK packages.
Motivation: multiple downstream teams reported small behavioral differences between SDKs (auth header edge cases when token is rotated, inconsistent retry backoff defaults, and streaming callback ergonomics). These differences cause subtle production bugs and complicate cross-language examples. This change unifies the behavior and provides clear migration notes.
Changes (high level):
1) Auth: introduce AuthProvider interface and move token refresh responsibilities to a single helper used by all SDKs; ensure Authorization header normalization (Bearer casing and whitespace trimming) and add test coverage for rotated-token scenarios.
2) Retries: standardize RetryPolicy naming and default backoff (exponential with jitter, max_retries=3) and surface consistent retry hooks for observability.
3) Streaming APIs: improve ergonomic convenience helpers for streaming responses (on_message/on_complete callbacks and a simple async iterator in Python/TS; in Go exported StreamReader with Context cancellation and buffered channel semantics).
4) Parity and ergonomics: rename some methods to match canonical names used in server docs (create_completion -> completion.create, stream -> completion.stream), add deprecation wrappers for backwards compatibility where feasible, and align error types across languages.
5) Version bumps: package.json / pyproject.toml / go.mod updates to v1.108.0 and changelog updates.

Migration notes (short):
- Python: streaming.async_streamer iterator is the new ergonomic API; old stream() remains but will be deprecated in 3 releases.
- TypeScript: use completion.stream helper which returns AsyncIterable<ResultChunk>. Old callback signature is still supported.
- Go: use StreamReader with Context and call Close() after stream completion; small adapter provided for existing streaming helpers.
- Retry defaults changed to max_retries=3 with bounded exponential backoff and jitter. If you relied on previous infinite retries, configure RetryPolicy explicitly.
Full migration doc: docs/sdk-migration-v1.108.0.md contains code snippets and before/after examples.
Recommended rollout: monitor error rates and retry metrics (sdk.retry.attempts, sdk.retry.failures) and streaming dropped-chunks metric.
